_about: What Sealcloak really is and does. Every article is checked against this. Never claim anything that is not here.
platform: Android 8.0 or newer only. No iPhone, iPad, Windows, Mac or web version.

price.free: 3 vaults, 100 photos, 10 videos, 10 documents, 10 audio files
price.pro: Unlimited files and vaults, calculator disguise, custom icon, Coerce, erase after wrong patterns
price.plansUSD: Weekly $1.49, Monthly $4.99, Annual $14.99 (7-day free trial), Lifetime $29.99
price.plansINR: Weekly ₹49, Monthly ₹149, Annual ₹599 (7-day free trial), Lifetime ₹999

privacy: No account, no email, no phone number
The app has no internet permission at all, so it cannot upload anything
No cloud, no sync, no analytics, no ads
Opts out of Android's automatic cloud backup of app data
security: Every file encrypted on the phone with AES-256-GCM
Pattern turned into a key with Argon2id
Each vault has its own random master key, wrapped with help from the Android Keystore
Screenshots and screen recording blocked inside the app
Wrong patterns: first 4 free, then growing waits that changing the clock does not skip
unlock: Optional fingerprint or face unlock (the pattern always still works)
9-word recovery phrase for each vault if the pattern is forgotten
Nobody, including the developer, can open a vault without the pattern or phrase
features: Hide photos, videos, documents (PDF etc.), audio, text notes and scans

Take photos and videos from inside the app: they are saved straight into the vault, not the gallery (it uses the phone's camera app, and some camera apps keep their own copy, so users should check once)
Document scanner that makes a PDF
Up to 3 separate vaults free, each with its own pattern; nothing shows how many exist
Intruder photos (optional): from the 3rd wrong pattern in a row, the front camera takes a photo, viewable only after unlocking
Coerce (Pro): a harmless decoy vault with its own pattern, for when someone forces you to unlock; can optionally erase other vaults, off by default, needs the word PERMIT typed
Calculator disguise (Pro): app becomes a working calculator; type the secret code (4–8 digits) and hold = for 2 seconds
Custom icon (Pro): any picture and name on the home screen
Erase after wrong patterns (Pro): off by default, needs PERMIT typed
Encrypted backups by hand or weekly/monthly schedule to a folder you choose; restore on a new phone with the recovery phrase or a passphrase
Share files as a passphrase-locked package
Adding files offers to keep the originals; the user deletes originals from the gallery themselves
notTrue: There is no cloud backup or sync
There is no PIN or password unlock for the vault (pattern, plus optional fingerprint)
Sealcloak cannot recover a vault if both pattern and recovery phrase are lost
It cannot hide other apps; it can only disguise itself
It does not hide files inside other apps such as WhatsApp; files must be added to the vault
